law_name: Copyright Act 1913 (Wet Auteursrecht 1913, Auteurswet) as amended up to S.B. 2015 No. 83
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (from 1 January of the year after death; anonymous/posthumous works 50 years from publication; per Commons summary)
fair_use_exceptions: Narrow exceptions listed in arts. 15bis-17, e.g. quotation with source (unconfirmed)
notes: 2015 amendment challenged by collecting society SASUR before Constitutional Court (Feb 2024); WCT/WPPT not confirmed
